sourceContract: Claude Code hook JSON protocol (Stop) as observed on print / `claude -p` sessions, where assistant text is on `result` rather than `last_assistant_message` and Anthropic `message.usage` counters may be attached
author: otel-hook claude adapter (agent)
sanitization: result is an invented placeholder sentence; session, prompt, and path values are fabricated; token counts are arbitrary small integers, not measurements of any real model call.
notes: Supports os-factory/har#203 / os-factory/har#220: print-session generation.end must carry a response body when the Stop payload has assistant text.
